issues.description: Caption keyword accents still mix cyan and gold in one page ('вдвое' cyan, 'сильнее' gold) while the headline uses gold for 'вдвое'. Same cyan accent in s05 ('лишь двадцать') and s07 ('перестроит' cyan in the caption, gold in the headline). The cyan clashes with the gold-only accent system. Not fixed since the previous review.

Captions repeat the words of the kinetic headline right below it ('Выиграет тот' / 'кто перестроит процессы' under 'Выиграет тот, кто перестроит'; s04 and s03 do the same). This stacks redundant text. Consider a smaller caption style or dropping the keyword highlight when a headline is on screen.

The hook shows the headline as plain centred text. The storyboard called for a gold ring closing around 88% and a slow punch-in, and neither appears in hook frames 0.1–3.0 s. The headline also differs from the onScreenText in script.json ('88% внедрили ИИ. Выигрывают не все.' vs '88% — выигрывают не все'). The wording is correct, but this departs from the plan.
subtitles.srt (the sidecar file, not burned in) drops punctuation: 'то что раньше не могли' has no comma and 'Подпишись больше разборов' has no dash. On-screen text is correct.

notes: Every issue from the previous review was checked on this render. Fixed: the s04 org-chart now starts at y≈295, below the 250 px unsafe zone. The hook is fully readable at 0.1 s, with only the last few px of the underline still drawing. At every cut (4.5/4.65, 8.5/8.7, 11.1, 17.5/17.7, 21.5/21.7 s) no caption page carries over. Footnotes are larger and legible. The s02 label now reads 'делают то, что раньше не могли'. On-screen text matches the script, there are no spelling errors, the numbers (88/58/26/71%) are correct, nothing overlaps on rest frames, and the CTA end frame is clean. What remains is polish only: cyan/gold accent consistency and captions duplicating headlines. Manual review needed: how natural the TTS voice sounds and how it pronounces 'ИИ', how well the music/SFX fit and the voice/music balance, and whether the placeholder brand 'Reels Studio / @reels.studio' is the intended account.
